title: Volvo FH16 Custom Built Hi-tensile FUPS Bullbar to suit Collision Avoidance System #10
description: Volvo FH16 Hi-tensile FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Additional uprights to lower bar for extra protection. Collision avoidance System compatible. Indicator repeater lights included & custom driving light mounts as required. Provsion for Dangerous Goods sign on alluminium plate. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate. Optional tow pin on customer request.
